milestones.title: M14 Performance Benchmarking, Runtime Hardening & Device Detail UX
milestones.objective: Establish opt-in, bounded in-application performance diagnostics; harden runtime behavior; and reorganize Device Detail with tab-scoped data loading.

workUnits.title: WU14-01 Performance Contract & Baseline Design
workUnits.objective: Freeze the performance vocabulary, reusable-core boundary, baseline evidence plan, and Device Detail query-ownership design before product optimization.
acceptanceCriteria: Stable operation labels and bounded session/report model are documented
Core boundary excludes Pi-Hub models and platform adapters
Baseline scenarios and evidence/invariant distinction are defined
All existing Device Detail sections and query ownership are mapped
Later WU dependencies are explicit

workUnits.title: WU14-02 Reusable Benchmark Core & Performance Diagnostics
workUnits.objective: Implement the reusable bounded Rust benchmark core, typed commands, sampler, and minimal in-app diagnostics surface.
acceptanceCriteria: One bounded active session
No sampler while inactive
Core has no Pi-Hub domain/SSH/Docker/Tauri imports
Report is redacted and exportable

workUnits.title: WU14-03 Pi-Hub Instrumentation & Synthetic Workloads
workUnits.objective: Instrument selected production paths and provide deterministic fixture-backed local workload profiles.
acceptanceCriteria: Stable labels have bounded aggregation
2/5/10-device profiles run without Pis or VMs
Sensitive data is absent from reports

workUnits.title: WU14-04 Baseline Run & Request/Backend Audit
workUnits.objective: Collect and document pre-optimization local baseline evidence and request/backend audit.
acceptanceCriteria: All approved scenarios have evidence or a documented unavailable reason
Measured hotspots and duplicate work are identified
No machine-specific CI thresholds are introduced

workUnits.title: WU14-05 Device Detail Tabs, Frontend Performance & Historical Layout
workUnits.objective: Implement accessible Device Detail tabs, tab-scoped expensive loading, and Historical containment fixes supported by baseline evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: All sections remain reachable
Historical and Activity load only on their tabs
No duplicate scheduler
7d/30d stay contained

workUnits.title: WU14-06 Windows Launch & Tray Lifecycle Hardening
workUnits.objective: Use evidence to resolve Windows Start/icon discoverability and tray/explicit Exit lifecycle behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Start discovery/icon configuration is coherent
Explicit Exit clears intended app work and tray
Shell-only residuals are distinguished from process leaks

workUnits.title: WU14-07 Evidence-Based Runtime Optimization
workUnits.objective: Apply only improvements supported by before/after evidence and add regression coverage.
acceptanceCriteria: Every optimization has a measured reason and result
Semantics remain unchanged
Regression coverage protects the result

workUnits.title: WU14-08 Performance Regression Gates & Closure
workUnits.objective: Establish deterministic gates, final evidence, documentation, AIQT closure, and release readiness for M14.
acceptanceCriteria: Deterministic regression gates pass
Final before/after evidence exists
M14 exit criteria and AIQT state match implementation

dependencies.reason: Implementation must follow the frozen contract.
Baseline evidence requires instrumentation and profiles.
Windows lifecycle work uses baseline/process evidence.
Final runtime optimization follows tab/query changes.
Closure follows all evidence-backed implementation work.
